body.$description: Noto Sans covers Latin; Noto Sans Devanagari is the fallback for Hindi text the base family doesn't cover. Locked 2026-08-20 — see LEARNING.md Chunk 04.

mono.$description: System monospace stack, deliberately not a downloaded font — for tabular/numeric data (prices, quantities) without adding another network request on a weak-connectivity audience.

100.$description: 12px at the assumed 16px root. rem, not px — decisions/decision-rem-for-typography-px-for-layout.md: type must respect a user's browser/OS text-size setting; layout stays px so that setting can't shift which responsive breakpoint applies.

400.$description: Base body size — 16px at the assumed 16px root.

tight.$description: Large headings. Latin script only — see the Devanagari note on this token family in project memory / LEARNING.md.

wide.$description: Small caps / labels. Latin script only.
